metadata.title: Uncentered Blaschke-Santaló inequalities for the Gaussian measure
metadata.abstract: We study the maximizers of the generalized volume product \[ \gamma_\sigma^n(A)\,\gamma_\sigma^n(A^\circ) \] among all measurable subsets $A\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, where $A^\circ$ denotes the polar set of $A$, and where $\gamma_\sigma^n$ denotes the centered Gaussian probability measure on $\mathbb{R}^n$ with covariance $\sigma^2 I_n$, $\sigma>0$. It turns out that the maximizers depend on $\sigma$. We prove that they exist and are convex bodies. In dimension $n=1$, we find the exact form of the maximizers. In dimension $n\ge 2$, we show that they are smooth bodies of revolution whose support function satisfies a certain differential equation. Moreover, for $\sigma^2 \le \frac{1}{n}$ we show that the Euclidean unit ball is the unique maximizer, while this is no longer the case for $\sigma^2\ge {\frac{2}{n+1}}$. In dimension $n=2$, we close the gap by showing that the Euclidean unit ball is the unique maximizer for $\sigma^2 \le \frac{2}{3}$.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 研究高斯测度下不要求中心化的极体体积积最大化，证明最大者存在且为凸体，刻画一维，并给高维旋转体方程及球为最大者的参数范围。
analysis.breakthrough: 显示最大者随方差发生变化，并在二维消除部分阈值缺口。
analysis.limitations: n≥3 的球唯一性区间与失效区间仍有缺口；不要把二维结论推广到所有维度。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露使用 LLM 检查计算并建议部分论证，所有陈述与证明由作者核验。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露使用 LLM 检查计算并建议部分论证，所有陈述与证明由作者核验。

analysis.priorityReason: 度量测度与凸几何不等式相交，变分刻画有复用潜力。
